Generate Educational UX Recommendations

Source: R/ux_recommendations.R
ux_recommendations.Rd

Generates learning recommendations based on task-level usability results from a UX learning exercise.

Usage

ux_recommendations(exercise)

Arguments

exercise

An object returned by ux_learning().

Value

A list containing a summary and prioritised educational recommendations.

Details

Priority levels are based on task success rates: High: below 80 percent. Medium: from 80 to below 90 percent. Low: 90 percent or above.

These thresholds are educational guidelines, not universal usability benchmarks.

Examples

exercise <- ux_learning()
ux_recommendations(exercise)
